issues.message: the record ends BEFORE the far-boundary round trip arrives — waveguide_port[0] (+x): T/tau_far = 0.4049. T = 1.7252 ns (1425 steps x dt = 1.2107 ps; num_periods = 20 at freq_max = 11.6 GHz), tau_far = 2 x far_path / v_g = 4.2613 ns. far_path = 152.4 mm (port plane 12.7 mm to the x-hi outer wall on a 121.9 mm domain, absorber pad 43.18 mm included); v_g(f_min)/c = 0.23859 at f_min = 6.75 GHz with the port's discrete cutoff f_c = 6.5551 GHz. num_periods >= 149 makes T/tau_far >= 3. Finer grids need more — measured 3, 5 and 8 at a/18, a/36 and a/72 on the WR-90 battery. A multimode port is audited on its lowest-cutoff mode, so this is a lower bound.

The +1 difference is the KNOWN shipped offset — apply_waveguide_port_e places the '-' port's E correction at x_index + 1 — not an asymmetry in this setup. Reported as information.
